name: syntax-error-sound
description: Plays your custom sound whenever a syntax error occurs while coding.

commands.title: Syntax Error Sound: Play Test Sound

syntaxErrorSound.enabled.description: Enable or disable playing the audio on syntax errors.

syntaxErrorSound.debounceDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing stops before evaluating syntax errors.

syntaxErrorSound.cooldownDelay.description: Minimum milliseconds between audio playbacks to avoid overlapping.

syntaxErrorSound.onlyActiveDocument.description: Only trigger sound if the error is in the currently active editor document.
